config.goldentweaks.title: Golden Tweaks
config.goldentweaks.pickup.comment: Settings related to item pickup interaction.
config.goldentweaks.pickup.extended_reac: Additional pickup reach for creative and spectator players.
config.goldentweaks.pickup.search_box_in: Additional expansion size for the pickup search box.
config.goldentweaks.pickup.trace_bias.co: Entity tracing bias used during pickup detection.
config.goldentweaks.pickup.max_targets.c: Maximum number of item entities processed per click.
config.goldentweaks.pickup.allow_through: Allows item pickup through solid blocks.
config.goldentweaks.pickup.block_use.com: Prevents original right click behavior when using pickup interaction.
config.goldentweaks.pickup.allow_continu: Allows holding right click to continuously pick up nearby items.
config.goldentweaks.pickup.continuous_pi: Tick interval between continuous pickup scans while holding right click.
Cache vertex formats to reduce recompilation.
config.goldentweaks.render_cycle_pool_si: Size of the buffer pool for render cycles.
config.goldentweaks.renderbuffer_depth.c: Enable depth attachment for render buffers.
config.goldentweaks.fast_math.comment: Use faster but less accurate math functions.
config.goldentweaks.batch_text_rendering: Batch text draw calls for performance.
config.goldentweaks.balance.evolved_meka: Global multiplier for Evolved Mekanism solar generators. Affects all tiers' power output.
config.goldentweaks.balance.recycler_fac: Allow Mekanism Extras recycler factories to use Stack upgrades.
config.goldentweaks.feature.always_edibl: Allows all food items to be eaten even when the player is fully saturated.
config.goldentweaks.debug.debug_gui_insp: Shift + Middle Click widgets to inspect GUI class information
config.goldentweaks.debug.debug_gui_copy: Automatically copy GUI debug information to clipboard
